specified below.
1. The firms who fulfill the following requirements shall be eligible to apply. (Joint ventures are not accepted):
(A)
The approved and eligible contractors registered with CPWD in appropriate class of Building & Roads/composite category,
provided: -
The contractor associates specialized Agency having requisite work experience (as given in condition 1 (B) for "Repairing or

7 days of submission of PG otherwise the work shall not be awarded to the contractor and the agency will be debarred from
participating in the tender again. The department may also forfeit the PG of the agency in such case.
OR
The contractor himself/ herself fulfills the prescribed eligibility criteria, fulfilling the condition 1 (B) given below for execution of
the repairing or Edward make Fire alarm system
(B)
Other experienced contractors/ specialized agency/ Firm who have satisfactorily completed the similar nature works as
mentioned below during the last seven years ending last day of month previous to the one in which tenders are invited:
1
Three similar works each cost in got less than Rs.2,11,998/-i.e.40% of estimated cost put to tender, the work shall include
Repairing or Edward make fire alarm system.
OR
Two similar works each cost in got less than Rs.3,17,997/-i.e.60% of estimated cost put to tender, the work shall include
"Repairing or Edward make Fire alarm system"
OR

shall include "repairing of Edward make Fire alarm system"
1
Similar work shall mean works of "Repairing or Edward make Fire alarm system".

•
Should not have incurred any loss (profit after tax should be positive) in more than two years during the last five years ending 31st

•
Should have a Solvency of 40% of estimated cost or Net Worth Certificate of 10% of estimated cost (Scanned copy of original

1. Copy of Enlistment Order and certificate of work experience and other documents as specified in the press notice shall be
scanned and uploaded to the e-Tendering website within the period of bid submission. However, certified copy of all the scanned and
uploaded documents as specified in press notice shall have to be submitted by the lowest bidder only along with physical EMD of
the scanned copy of EMD uploaded within a week physically in the office of tender opening authority. Online bid documents submitted
by intending bidders shall be opened only of those bidders, whose original EMD deposited with any division of CPWD and
other documents scanned and uploaded are found in order.
2.
The intending bidder must read the terms and conditions of CPWD-6 carefully. He should only submit his bid if he considers himself
eligible and he is in possession of all the documents required.
3.
Information and Instructions for bidders posted on website shall form part of bid document.
4.
The bid document consisting of plans, specifications, the schedule of quantities of various types of items to be executed and the set
of terms and conditions of the contract to be complied with and other necessary documents can be seen and downloaded
from website www.tenderwizard.com/cpwd or www.cpwd.gov.in.
5.
Those contractors not registered on the website mentioned above, are required to get registered before and. If needed they can be
imparted training on online bidding process as per details available on the website.
6.
The intending bidder must have valid class-III digital signature to submit the bid.
7.
On opening date, the contractor can login and see the bid opening process. After opening of bids he will receive the
competitor bid sheets.
8.
Contractor can upload documents in the form of JPG format and PDF format.
9.
Contractor must ensure to quote percentage rate of works component as given in template. The column meant for quoting percentage
rate in figures appears in pink color and them om entreat is entered, it turns sky blue.
10.
In addition to this, while selecting any of the cells a warning appears that if any cell is left blank the same shall be treated as "0".
Therefore, if any cell is left blank and no rate is quoted by the bidder, rate of such item shall be treated as "0" (ZERO). However, if
tenderer does not quote any percentage above or below on the total amount of the tender or any section / sub head in percentage tender,
the tender shall be treated as invalid and not consider lowest tender.
11.
The department reserves the right to reject any prospective application without assigning any reason and to restrict the list of qualified
contractors to any number deemed suitable by it, if too many bids are received satisfying the laid down criterion.
12.
In case of Govt/ Semi Govt. works, the completion certificate issued by the Executive Engineer or above level officer shall be required.
13.
